requirements.requirement: One-call single-snapshot dossier includes supported materialized and referenced pawn scopes and domain metadata.
Normal one-call timeline automatically refreshes configured sources then examines every compatible snapshot in a pinned generation; freshness mode/window and every candidate outcome are explicit.
Separate campaign, pawn and event identity; no merges by names, paths, filenames or mtime alone.
Distinguish absolute, game-relative, biological and wall-clock fields; preserve unknown times and normalization provenance.
Separate recorded events, observations, differences and inferences; missing records never prove death.
No automatic save ancestry; equal-tick conflicts, event conflicts and asserted branches remain explicit.
All semantic claims resolve to exact snapshot hashes, canonical XML paths, raw values and interpretation rules.
Context includes historical aliases, related people, holder chains, maps, factions, roles, mods/research and directly linked events/art.
Unknown/custom pawn fields remain inspectable lossless evidence with explicit unknown semantics and coverage.
Read-only sources, secure bounded parsing, safe cancellation, atomic index generations and strict configured-source authority.
Python, JSON CLI and read-only MCP use equivalent shared services; existing v1 contracts remain intact.

H0-pinned private corpus and pawn cohort receive every distinct supported semantic fact in losslessly factored one-call context; caps are calibrated within 16MiB without dropping facts, and oversized results never silently truncate.
Independent oracles precede implementation; failed attempts retained; fresh reviewer tests final packaged candidate.
No private save-derived content in public source/history/distributions; no publication or host registration inferred from development.

completion_rule: Every mandatory gate must pass against the final packaged candidate; skips, missing evidence and documentation checks are not product acceptance.
